diabetes.data_source: CDC/NCHS National Health and Nutrition Examination Survey (NHANES) 1999-2023 public-use data, rebuilt from the raw CDC files into data/nhanes/nhanes_1999_2023_research.csv.gz by scripts/fetch_nhanes.py and scripts/rebuild_nhanes.py (public domain; cite NHANES).
diabetes.label_definition: 1 if HbA1c measured at the NHANES exam was 5.7% or higher (prediabetes or diabetes range), else 0. A single lab value, not a diagnosis.
diabetes.population: NHANES adults 18+ with exam data who had never been told they have diabetes (borderline or unknown answers left out) and had HbA1c measured.

split.method: Test: NHANES 2021-2023 cycle only. Validation: stratified 20% of the earlier cycles (random_state=42). Training: the rest of the earlier cycles.

diabetes.selection_rule: Logistic Regression for every condition, because its score moves one way per answer and each answer's effect can be explained; the other families are benchmarks. The threshold maximises Youden's J (sensitivity + specificity - 1) on the validation set.

ada_comparison.score: Partial ADA risk test points (Bang et al. 2009): age, sex, high blood pressure, physical activity, BMI. No family history or gestational diabetes; blank answers score 0.

heart.data_source: CDC Behavioral Risk Factor Surveillance System (BRFSS) 2022, via Kaggle 'Indicators of Heart Disease (2022 UPDATE)' by Kamil Pytlak (CC0).
heart.label_definition: 1 if the respondent was ever told they had a heart attack (a past event, not a future one), else 0.
heart.population: US adults who answered the BRFSS 2022 telephone survey (complete-answer rows).

split.method: Stratified random split, 64% train / 16% validation / 20% test (random_state=42). BRFSS 2022 is a single survey year.

heart.selection_rule: Logistic Regression for every condition, because its score moves one way per answer and each answer's effect can be explained; the other families are benchmarks. The threshold maximises Youden's J (sensitivity + specificity - 1) on the validation set.

kidney.data_source: CDC/NCHS National Health and Nutrition Examination Survey (NHANES) 1999-2023 public-use data, rebuilt from the raw CDC files into data/nhanes/nhanes_1999_2023_research.csv.gz by scripts/fetch_nhanes.py and scripts/rebuild_nhanes.py (public domain; cite NHANES).
kidney.label_definition: 1 if eGFR (CKD-EPI 2021) was below 60 or urine albumin-to-creatinine ratio was 30 mg/g or higher at that single visit, else 0. A single-visit kidney marker, not confirmed chronic kidney disease.
kidney.population: NHANES adults 18+ with both eGFR and urine albumin-to-creatinine ratio measured.

split.method: Test: NHANES 2021-2023 cycle only. Validation: stratified 20% of the earlier cycles (random_state=42). Training: the rest of the earlier cycles.

kidney.selection_rule: Logistic Regression for every condition, because its score moves one way per answer and each answer's effect can be explained; the other families are benchmarks. The threshold maximises Youden's J (sensitivity + specificity - 1) on the validation set.
